1.0 | Road & Traffic Operations
Road and Traffic Operations require personnel to safely manage traffic using clear, visible control devices for lane and road closures, ensuring proper guidance and detours when needed. All hazards must be secured, removed safely, and the roadway restored once operations are complete.

1.1 - Traffic Control Devices
All department personnel are required to utilize traffic control devices to ensure civilian safety. You may utilize cones, barricades, arrow boards, warning lights, and any other devices you deem fit.

1.2 - Lane Closures
All department personnel are required to set up lane closures in situations where deemed fit, all lane closures must be clearly visible and must easily convey where to go.
